author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: Inconsistent Data Labeling
challenge.description: #reliability_ruth# believes that labeling should be fully automated and governed to ensure consistent data quality. #data_dave# wants to keep it manual for flexibility. #data_dave# is willing to compromise on a semi-manual approach, but #reliability_ruth# insists on strict governance.

output.content: We need to lock down the labeling workflow before the next sprint. I am not open to any automation that strips my direct control over the annotation process. If we introduce scripts that override manual decisions, I will block the release. The pipeline must remain in a state where every label is verified by a human eye before it hits the training set. Do not propose tools that bypass this check. I will not sign off on a governed system if it means I cannot see and correct every single entry. Keep the process manual and I will ensure the data quality stays high. Any attempt to automate this away is a hard no from me.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a line whose crossing (automation bypassing human verification) results in a refusal to sign off or a block on the release.
